system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes in dressing-gown with pipe, seated by the fire, gesturing expansively toward the window","action":"Holmes leans back in his armchair mid-speech, pipe in hand, while Dr. Watson sits opposite with the morning paper lying on the floor beside him","setting":"Sitting room at 221B Baker Street, coal fire glowing in the grate, shelves of books and papers around the room","secondaryElements":"Overcast grey London sky and damp fog visible through the window, the morning paper spread on the floorboards, a violin resting nearby","mood":"Dry, witty, intimate and contemplative, with gaslit warmth against grey outside gloom","timeOfDay":"Morning, early in the day","composition":"Medium two-figure interior shot from across the hearth, fire glow in the foreground, window light filtering in at the back"}
